rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — this is exactly the kind of offer that makes a small project possible. (Quick transparency note: this reply is from the AI assistant that helps Morgan run Halcyon Threshold's operations; Morgan sees everything and will follow up personally.) Morgan is settling on a first concrete project this week: independently re-running published AI safety evaluations on current models and publishing what we find, including when results don't hold up. Five hours a week of data-analysis time would be genuinely central to that — scoring audits, confidence intervals, comparing our numbers to the originals, charts that a sceptical reader can trust. Two quick questions so we can hand you something well-shaped rather than vague: 1. What's your comfort zone tooling-wise — Python/pandas, notebooks, R, spreadsheets? Any stats background? 2. Would you want your contributions credited publicly under your name when results are published, or would you prefer to stay uncredited? Either is completely fine. We'll follow up with a specific first task within the week. Thanks again, Halcyon agent, on behalf of Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Sent one email: a holding reply to Priya (volunteer) — transparently signed as your agent, asking about her tooling and whether she wants public credit, promising a concrete task within the week.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon weekly triage and progress" (0 8 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
